name: Balsamic Chicken Salad with Goat Cheese, Cranberries & Lemony Arugula
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Juice lemon into a large bowl; add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; cut into matchsticks and add to the bowl with the dressing. Set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces; season with salt and pepper.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and sauté, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, 4-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and slice onion into thin half-moons.
When the chicken is done, use a slotted spoon to transfer it to a plate (leaving cooking juices in the skillet).
Return skillet to medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 4 minutes.

Add vinegar and sugar to the skillet with the onion; continue to cook, stirring constantly, until the vinegar is reduced, 1-2 minutes. Return chicken to the skillet (along with any accumulated juices), stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
Divide salad between plates and top with balsamic chicken; crumble goat cheese over top and sprinkle with cranberries. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
